name: Botanical Heap Analysis

VINIT.justification: The initial state before a specific plant identity or IG tuple is loaded into the engine register.

TANCH.justification: The terminal state where all parameters are fixed and the pharmaceutical instruction set is closed and ready for execution.

AFWD.justification: The forward transformation of plant material into solute via solvent interaction and thermal kinetics.

AREV.justification: The reverse assessment of the marc or residual material to verify extraction efficiency against the endpoint criterion.

CLINK.justification: The chaining of the botanical catalog identity to the specific pharmacy folio and its associated operation class.

IMSCRIB.justification: The identity state where successive extraction fractions are identical, signaling that the process has reached self-referential criticality.

FSPLIT.justification: The division of the session into specific operation branches equal to the pharmacy operation count n_ops.

FFUSE.justification: The recombination of all process branches into a single validated preparation vessel.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative confirmation that the balneological vessel can hold the required structural depth of the recipe.

EVALF.justification: The negative state where the vessel capacity or closure ratio fails to meet the pharmaceutical address requirements.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous presence of a heat opcode and a cold-maceration constraint which must be held until the engine reparses the target to the excipient.

IFIX.justification: The permanent append-only fixation of protocol parameters onto the recipe opcode stream.
